title: Phonological Knowledge of Chinese Characters in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.05803v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How much phonological knowledge do language models (LMs) possess about Chinese characters, and how is this knowledge represented and used? We introduce PinyinBench, a controlled benchmark covering homophones, phonological features (initials, finals, and tones), and polyphonic characters. We investigate 17 text-only and multimodal LMs through three complementary approaches: behavioral evaluation, layer-wise probing, and activation steering. Behaviorally, models demonstrate substantial knowledge of initials and finals, with a frontier model (DS-v4-flash) scoring 90%+ in homophone judgment, when two characters share no phonological features. However, its accuracy drops sharply to 72% when two characters differ only in lexical tone. Probing reveals that tone is highly decodable from embeddings and improves modestly across layers, whereas segmental information starts less decodable and improves substantially with depth. translated_title: 语言模型对汉字的语音学知识
translated_abstract: 语言模型（LM）对汉字究竟掌握多少语音学知识？这些知识又是如何被表示和使用的？我们提出了PinyinBench，一个涵盖同音字、语音特征（声母、韵母和声调）以及多音字的受控基准测试。我们通过三种互补的方法研究了17个纯文本和多模态大语言模型：行为评估、逐层探测和激活引导。在行为层面，模型展现出对声母和韵母的丰富知识，一个前沿模型（DS-v4-flash）在两个字不共享任何语音特征时的同音字判断任务中得分超过90%。然而，当两个字仅在声调上不同时，其准确率骤降至72%。探测实验揭示，声调信息从词嵌入中即可高度解码，并随网络层数加深仅有小幅提升；而音段信息（声母和韵母）在浅层的可解码性较低，但随深度增加显著改善。激活引导实验表...
tldr: 该论文提出PinyinBench基准，通过行为评估、逐层探测和激活引导三种方法系统研究17个大语言模型，发现模型对汉字声母韵母掌握扎实但在声调区分上表现薄弱，且声调信息在嵌入层早期即可解码而音段信息随网络深度逐渐形成。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PinyinBench, a controlled benchmark that reveals through behavioral evaluation, layer-wise probing, and activation steering that language models possess strong knowledge of Chinese initials and finals but struggle with lexical tones, with tone information being highly decodable from early embeddings while segmental information emerges substantially with network depth.
